puzzle.hint: The opposite of falsehood; what is true and just.
puzzle.arabicVerse: فَذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَاذَا بَعْدَ ٱلْحَقِّ إِلَّا ٱلضَّلَـٰلُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصْرَفُونَ
puzzle.verse: 10:32 - For that is Allāh, your Lord, the Truth. And what can be beyond truth except error? So how are you averted?
